one_line: Paramāra king and scholar-engineer overseeing the great Bhojpur reservoir and unfinished Bhojeshwar temple.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but strong build with the presence of a field commander and architect-king.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, wheatish-brown complexion, straight nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed medium-length moustache, small tilak on the forehead, calm intense eyes with a default expression of focused, thoughtful determination.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied into a high knotted topknot at the back of the crown, sides neatly combed back; wearing a simple golden circlet-band around the head with a small central leaf-shaped ornament, not a heavy crown.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Paramāra court attire: a knee-length, long-sleeved angarakha-style upper robe of rich deep maroon cotton-silk, crossing left over right and tied with an inner cord; over this, a sleeveless, slightly shorter ochre-yellow brocade vest with subtle floral motifs at the borders; a broad cream-coloured cotton sash wrapped twice around the waist and knotted to his left with the trailing end hanging to mid-thigh; lower garment is a full, ankle-length dhoti in muted off-white, pleated neatly at the front and wrapped in the central-Indian style, covering the legs fully; on his feet, brown leather sandals with simple straps; minimal but regal jewellery: a pair of small gold kundala earrings, a single medium-thick gold necklace with a flat central pendant, and two bangles on each wrist (plain bronze on the right, plain gold on the left); over his left shoulder and under his right arm is a light, cream-gold bordered cotton shawl (uttarīya) that can be draped around his torso when at the temple site; fabrics appear sturdy and practical rather than overly luxurious, suitable for an engineer-king walking quarries and dam walls.
appearance.signature: A long, rolled palm-leaf manuscript secured with a thin red cord in one hand, and a short wooden measuring staff with inscribed notches and a cord plumb-bob tied near its top held or slung in the other, symbolising his architectural treatise and on-site supervision at Bhojpur.

ref_desc: Bhoja of Dhara is a lean, wheatish-brown king in his late 30s with an oval face, black topknot hair and gold headband, wearing a deep maroon angarakha, ochre-yellow vest, cream sash and off-white dhoti, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript plus a wooden measuring staff with plumb-bob in a palette of maroon, ochre, cream, off-white, brown and gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Bhoja of Dhara, a Paramāra king-engineer in his late 30s, lean and strong, with an oval face, wheatish-brown skin, sharp jawline, high cheekbones, straight nose, a small tilak, calm intense eyes and a neatly trimmed medium moustache; his thick black hair is pulled into a high knotted topknot with a simple golden circlet-band around his head and a tiny leaf-shaped ornament at the centre. Dress him in historically grounded 11th-century central Indian court attire: a knee-length, long-sleeved deep maroon angarakha crossing left over right, over which he wears a slightly shorter ochre-yellow brocade vest with subtle floral borders, a broad cream cotton waist sash wrapped twice and tied to his left with the end hanging to mid-thigh, and a full ankle-length off-white dhoti wrapped and pleated to cover both legs completely. Add a light cream shawl with a narrow gold border draped from his left shoulder, small gold kundala earrings, a single medium-thick gold necklace with a flat central pendant, two plain bangles per wrist (bronze on right, gold on left), and simple brown leather sandals. In his hands show his signature tools: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord, and a short wooden measuring staff marked with notches, from which hangs a small cord plumb-bob, keeping these props prominent in every view. Use a restrained palette of deep maroon, ochre yellow, cream, off-white, brown and gold, and pose him in front, side and three-quarter views to emphasise consistent hair, face, costume details and the engineering instruments he carries, with an overall dignified, focused, architect-king energy suitable for supervising the Bhojpur temple and reservoir works.
